Sweet Avocado Creme
By: Gorey
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk
1 medium avocado, pitted and peeled
1 teaspoon honey

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in blender. 2 Blend until smooth. 3 You could also mash everything by hand, until smooth and creamy.) 4 Serve alone in small bowls, or with butter or sugar cookies.

About


This combination is sweet, creamy, pretty to look at and delicious. While it may be a surprise or sound odd, avocadoes are often eaten this way in Asian cuisine. A must try dish, even for die-hard (savory) guacamole addicts.
